graph_contract.write_model: Additive AlphaDocumentV2, AlphaChunkV2, EvidenceObservationV2, TemporalRelationObservationV2 nodes; temporal facts never average or overwrite aggregate relationship evidence.
graph_contract.unknown_time_policy: Unknown required time is retained with is_quarantined=true and excluded from temporal traversal.
graph_contract.legacy_default: Callers constructing the legacy GraphDocument shape continue through the unchanged legacy entity/relationship adapter; no route or namespace is deleted or switched.

retrieval_contract.shared_context: One validated ForecastContext is passed unchanged to Vector and Graph branches and returned with the fused result.
retrieval_contract.vector_boundary: ticker, as_of, dataset_version, and historical=true are delegated to the Stage-03 fail-closed retriever before ranking.
retrieval_contract.graph_boundary: Temporal Cypher filters quarantine, ticker, dataset version, relation type, publication, retrieval, filing, and effective interval before returning observations.
retrieval_contract.backend_failure: A temporal Graph error returns an explicit graph_error degradation and never falls back to unbounded legacy traversal.
retrieval_contract.citation_identity: Vector and Graph citations preserve shared document_id/chunk_id/evidence_id; Graph adds observation_id. Both provenance paths survive RRF deduplication.

leakage_result.details: Temporal Graph requires known publication/retrieval/effective-start time; rejects future publication/retrieval/filing, closed effective intervals, quarantine, wrong ticker, and wrong dataset before traversal. Vector uses the identical context before ranking. Context-bound failures do not fall back to legacy.
